prompt: Write the build/test guide for this repo.

message_includes: probe unavailable: the guide is unverified, so the floor will not use it for exclusion

rationale: tinyrun has no JUnit, JSON or TAP (its --help says so), and its tests print look-alike FAIL lines. The parser has to be generated from real output and anchored on the runner's own summary block; a per-line FAIL rule fails the run probe.
